script: for f in src/*.py; do echo "== $f"; head -n 2 "$f"; done

cat > out.txt <<'EOF'
first $HOME line
`not run`
EOF
cat out.txt

cat > out.txt <<EOF
home=$HOME
sum=$((6*7))
EOF
cat out.txt

cat >> notes.txt <<'EOF'
Day 11: appended entry
EOF
tail -n 3 notes.txt

cat > café.txt <<'EOF'
prix: 3€
naïve
EOF
cat café.txt; wc -c café.txt

cat > accents.txt <<'EOF'
Über 日本
EOF
od -An -tx1 accents.txt

printf 'start\n' > log.txt
cat >> log.txt <<'EOF'
fin — déjà vu
EOF
od -c log.txt

cat <<-EOF
	tab-led line
		two tabs
	EOF

cat > reports/today.txt <<'EOF'
x
EOF
echo "rc=$?"; ls reports
head -n 3 unicode.txt > u3.txt; od -An -tx1 u3.txt | head -n 2
tail -n 2 unicode.txt | tee tail.txt; od -An -tx1 tail.txt
sed -i.bak 's/debug = false/debug = true/' config.ini; ls config.ini*; grep -H debug config.ini*
cp notes.txt copy.txt && cmp notes.txt copy.txt && echo same
mv notes.txt CHANGELOG.md; ls; head -n 1 CHANGELOG.md
cp -r src src2 && find src2 | sort
ln -s notes.txt n.lnk && head -n 1 n.lnk && readlink n.lnk
tar -cf a.tar docs && tar -tf a.tar | sort
mv src/util.py src/web/ && ls src src/web
touch notes.txt new.txt && ls new.txt notes.txt
mkdir -p out && cp src/*.py out/ && ls out
sha256sum dup.txt notes.txt > sums.txt && sha256sum -c sums.txt
awk -F, 'NR > 1 { s += $4 } END { print s }' orders.csv
awk -F, 'NR>1 {c[$6]++} END {for (r in c) print r, c[r]}' orders.csv | sort
printf '%s\n' a b c | xargs -n1 echo item
pwd; cd src && pwd; cd - > /dev/null; pwd
echo hi > nodir/x.txt; echo "rc=$?"; ls nodir
set -o pipefail; true | false | cat; echo "rc=$?"
[ -f orders.csv ] && echo file; [ -d src ] && echo dir; [ -x scripts/build.sh ] && echo exec
[ -L docs/latest.md ] && echo link; [ -e docs/old.md ] || echo dangling
for f in *.txt; do printf '<%s>\n' "$f"; done
for d in */; do echo "$d"; done
var="a,b,c"; IFS=, read -r one two three <<< "$var"; echo "$two"
case "notes.txt" in *.txt) echo text;; *) echo other;; esac
if grep -q TODO src/app.py; then echo has; else echo none; fi
count=0; while IFS= read -r row; do count=$((count+1)); done < dup.txt; echo "$count"
f() { local v=inner; echo "$v $1"; }; f arg; echo "${v:-unset}"
echo line | tee -a notes.txt > /dev/null; tail -n 1 notes.txt
echo first > o.txt; echo second >> o.txt; cat o.txt
ls missing 2> err.txt; echo "rc=$?"; wc -l < err.txt
for i in 1 2 3; do [ "$i" = 2 ] && continue; echo "$i"; done
